info.title: OpenSprite local model selection API
info.description: Authoritative draft v1 HTTP contract for the locally persisted default model selection. It stores no credential, dynamic model catalog, display label, or inference result.

requirements: Runtime and installer configurations must bind only to loopback addresses.
Deployments must reject non-loopback Host values and cross-origin browser mutations before model-selection routes become operational.

x-compatibility.policy: After the first consumer release, additions must be backward compatible; removals, renamed fields, enum narrowing, identifier changes, stricter validation, authentication changes, and semantic changes require an explicit versioned migration.

x-events.description: This contract defines no event, webhook, or WebSocket delivery behavior.

tags.name: model-selection
tags.description: One locally persisted default Provider and model identifier for future conversations.

get.summary: Read the saved default model selection
get.description: Returns null when no default model has been saved. This read is side-effect free: it does not create the settings file, decrypt a credential, read a dynamic model catalog, or contact a provider.

200.description: The saved selection, or null when no selection has been saved.

put.summary: Save or clear the default model selection
put.description: A non-null selection requires a currently connected provider but intentionally does not contact a provider or require membership in a model catalog. This keeps saved OpenRouter identifiers valid across temporary discovery failures. A null selection clears the saved value. Because the settings file currently contains only this value, clearing the last selection removes that file. Repeating the same request has the same saved result; no idempotency key is needed.

200.description: The requested value is now the saved default selection.

modelId.description: Stable provider model identifier. A whitespace-only value is invalid. It is not a display label and is not validated against a network catalog by this operation.

message.description: Stable, secret-safe public message. It never contains a credential, filesystem path, store identifier, or internal configuration detail.

InvalidRequest.description: Malformed JSON, unsupported media type, missing or unknown fields, an unsupported provider identifier, an empty model identifier, or a whitespace-only model identifier.

NotConnected.description: The requested Provider has no locally stored connection.

SettingsStoreUnavailable.description: The local model-settings file could not be safely read, written, or cleared. The response does not expose a path or storage detail.

SettingsOrCredentialStoreUnavailable.description: Either the local model-settings file or local Provider metadata could not be safely accessed. The response code distinguishes neither implementation nor path.

InternalError.description: An unexpected local backend error occurred.
